findings.title: Restrict slice IDs before using them in file paths
findings.description: `--slice` is accepted by `_nonempty`, which only strips whitespace and rejects an empty value. It is then interpolated into the start and baseline paths, which are later written with `write_text`. A value such as `../outside` can therefore write files outside the notes directory. Validate the slice ID against the intended numeric format, or verify the resolved paths remain within `NOTES_DIR`. The release ref is also interpolated into the log path before preflight validates it.

findings.title: Keep over-session names associated with their family
findings.description: Statistics coverage can include `volume_checks` for multiple volume families, and each check carries a `family`. `over_sessions` discards that field, while `_family_evidence` in `cutover_304_evidence.py:233` groups names only by product. Consequently, an over-count for one family can be reported with session names belonging to another family. Preserve the family in the collected names and match it when creating each failure.

findings.title: Include unheld spend when deriving the 30-day ceiling
findings.description: The generated cap rounds up `planned + trailing`, but the purchase guard also includes unheld provider-job costs in its 30-day total (`src/manta_trading/data/tick/spend_guard.py:240-252`). Those costs are also exposed in the estimate’s `unheld_jobs`. If unheld jobs exist, the printed PM command can set a cap that is still too low for the guard, so the suggested command does not resolve the refusal. Account for unheld costs when deriving the cap, or clearly report that the command is insufficient in that case.
